{{dablink|For other uses of the word "white," see [[White]].}}
The '''White Ribbon''' is a traditional symbol of truce in [[Arad Doman]] whereupon warring parties will set aside violence to enable a conference.{{ref|{{twotc}}, White Ribbon}} If one person offers the White Ribbon and his opponents accept it, they will be bound by oaths on their souls and hopes of salvation not to draw a weapon against each other or shed blood for three days.

The White Ribbon was most recently offered by [[Rodel Ituralde]] to the various [[Dragonsworn]] lords and [[Taraboner]] soldiers on [[Almoth Plain]] and in Arad Doman. Ituralde believed his order to do so came from King Alsalam, but it was actually sent by [[Graendal]]. The Dragonsworn and Taraboners accepted the White Ribbon and Ituralde convinced them to make a truce to battle the Seanchan.
